scope: Windows native game-local V95 offline translation

evidence_levels.E0: Documented format or source; not proven working
evidence_levels.E2: Original Windows V95 binary built and model/integrity tests passed
evidence_levels.E3: Owner's real game visibly translated, including choices and native speaker
evidence_levels.E4: Owner's game moved to another clean Windows machine and used offline

source_notes: Historical TX354 reported 0 of 52 physical Windows10 scenarios at its own date; this is not a claim that physical tests could never be completed later.
17 menu families are not 17 TX207 resource profiles and not five launcher variants.
The TX775 V95 package applies only to MV/MZ and is not part of unified R1 detector EXE.
Every adaptation must be validated before install and revert correctly without touching unrelated data.

Source-backed TX200 real Windows QA includes Godot official engine, Chromium Tyrano/VNM, Java JAR and i18next runtime plus GUI fixture tests for LCF, KAG, Unity, Unreal, GameMaker and Light.vn; all remain NOT_IN_R1.
No release-level real user-game certification exists merely from recorded synthetic Windows CI success; each family stays disabled in the R1 detector for installation.

families.name: RPG Maker
families.notes: RPG Maker MV/MZ tiene 26 pruebas originales con V95 y actualización local; 2000/2003 tuvo instalación/reversión GUI de LCF binario de proyectos desechables, NO integrado en el instalador nuevo.

families.name: Ren'Py
families.notes: Variantes 6.x/7.x/8.x requieren bridge Windows y pruebas de saves, menus y escena

families.name: Godot
families.notes: Motor oficial Godot 4.3 para Windows descargado con SHA512, ejecutó proyecto propio EN/JA→ES con V95, F10/clic y restauración; no juego comercial.

families.name: TyranoScript
families.notes: Chromium real presentó EN/JA→ES, elecciones, F10 y pausa/reanudación con API Tyrano de muestra; no motor comercial completo.

families.name: KiriKiri/KAG
families.notes: EXE V95 GUI tradujo guiones KAG UTF16 y conservó órdenes/negación/F10, restauración SHA; sin motor ejecutable de juego.

families.name: HTML5/NW.js
families.notes: Evidencia NW.js y web UI, múltiples runtimes/plugins sin certificar

families.name: Light.vn
families.notes: EXE V95 GUI instaló guiones y F10 y restauró/rechazó colisión; LightApp.exe de fixture NO ejecutable.

families.name: Flash/SWF
families.notes: SWF compilado/proyector bloqueado sin escritor reversible

families.name: SRPG Studio
families.notes: Solo exportaciones y lectura de recursos hasta demostrar texto nativo

families.name: Visual Novel Maker
families.notes: V95 GUI creó textos ES y F10 y Chromium real mostró dos escenas autoelaboradas; no videojuego VNM comercial.

families.name: WOLF RPG
families.notes: Lectores MPS/Data.wolf acotados; variantes packed no certificadas

families.name: Unity
families.notes: V95 EXE instaló componentes Mono/IL2CPP y verificó rollback SHA sobre carpetas sintéticas; no juego Unity ejecutable.

families.name: Unreal Engine
families.notes: V95 EXE tradujo LOCRES v2 binario de muestra y restauró SHA, rechazando IoStore; no juego Unreal ejecutable.

families.name: GameMaker
families.notes: V95 EXE tradujo cuatro cadenas STRG japonesas en data.win sintético conservando punteros y rollback SHA; no juego ejecutable.

families.name: Java/JVM
families.notes: Java 17 ejecutó JAR propio tras instalación GUI+V95 y leyó ResourceBundle ES, restauró inglés; no videojuego comercial.

families.name: RPG Developer Bakin
families.notes: Recursos autor y exportación; runtime real sin hook certificado

families.name: Node/i18next
families.notes: La librería i18next@23 en Node ejecutó traducción ES creada por V95 GUI y restauró originales; no juego NW.js comercial.

evidence_status_definitions.original-v95-mv-mz: Actual owner encrypted Windows V95 production candidate and original regressions, not owner-game certification
evidence_status_definitions.historical-engine-runtime: Windows original V95 GUI and genuinely launched official engine, but only with an authored disposable sample
evidence_status_definitions.historical-bounded-runtime: Windows original V95 GUI and real browser, Java or i18next running an authored sample, not a whole commercial game
evidence_status_definitions.historical-binary-fixture-gui: Windows original V95 GUI installed/recovered fixtures of real formats, no full engine play session
evidence_status_definitions.research-only: Sources and candidate runtime proofs do not yet qualify under a verified Windows original V95 GUI path
evidence_status_definitions.read-only: Only safe parsers, inventories or partial resources
